# ANALYSIS: Stage-1 Backtest for Edge Capture and OOS Validation

**Filed:** 2026-07-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are running the Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder harness to quantify the edge_capture of the current engine (or candidate set) and to validate out-of-sample (OOS) performance across 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18. This analysis will determine whether the engine meets the OP-16 edge_capture floor of 771 and assess OOS robustness.

## Mechanism

The autoresearch grinder harness executes a Stage-1 backtest over the specified date range, using real OPRA fills where available and applying the current engine's logic (including any active candidates from the leaderboard). The backtest computes:
- Engine P&L on J's winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04)
- Engine P&L on J's loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07 x2)
- Edge_capture = sum(winner P&L) - sum(max(0, loser P&L))
- Aggregate Sharpe ratio from the full OOS window
- Final score = edge_capture × aggregate_sharpe
Additionally, the harness validates OOS performance via walk-forward analysis and checks for real-fills slippage on the top 3 J days.

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>
- Grid must pass all gym validators (e.g., `test_*_setup_dispatch.py`, `test_*_engine.py`)
- Walk-forward OOS/IS Sharpe ratio ≥ 0.70
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days shows < ±20% diff vs BS-sim
- Edge_capture ≥ 771 (OP-16 floor)
- No anchor regression (J winner days unchanged or improved, loser days not worsened)
- Concentration check: top-5 days ≤ 200% of P&L (to avoid extreme tail dependence)
